name: Grafana
description: Dashboards over Prometheus, databases and logs. The admin password is generated here rather than left at the upstream default.

access.note: Sign in as admin with the password generated here. Grafana writes that password once, when it first creates its own database, so rotating this secret later will not change it — change it inside Grafana or with "grafana cli admin reset-admin-password".

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Grafana builds share links and OAuth redirects from this.

secrets.name: admin-password
secrets.label: Admin password
secrets.description: Generated here. The upstream image would otherwise start with admin/admin.

update.notes: Grafana migrates its database on first start after an upgrade. The 11 to 13 jump removes Angular plugin support outright, so a dashboard still relying on an Angular panel stops rendering.
